title: Shared Knowledge: File Watch Ingestor
description: Watches a document folder, reviews changed files with an agent, and ingests relevant ones into a shared knowledge base you can query later.
author: system

options.name: Shared Knowledge File Ingestor
options.description: Watch a folder of notes and reference docs, review changes, and add relevant files into a shared knowledge base.

nodes.script:
raw = input
if isinstance(raw, (bytes, bytearray)):
    text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
else:
    text = str(raw or '')
text = text.strip()
excerpt = text[:4000]
output = f"Review this changed document and decide if it belongs in a shared knowledge base. Respond with JSON only using this shape: {{\"ingest\": true|false, \"title\": \"...\", \"summary\": \"...\", \"tags\": [\"...\"], \"reason\": \"...\"}}. Only ingest stable reference material such as notes, specs, procedures, or useful datasets. Skip noise, temporary files, and trivial content. Document excerpt:\n\n{excerpt}"

instructions: You are curating a shared knowledge base for later retrieval.
Only ingest documents that are likely to remain useful to future questions.
Return valid JSON only. Never wrap the JSON in markdown fences.

nodes.description: Shared knowledge base built from watched files in storage/knowledge_inbox.
